hypothesis: The dense coarse-pitch oracle has goal-scale control headroom, but the prior selector saw only career pitchmix rates. The current row's official pitchmix counters can reconstruct the pitcher's current-season repertoire relative to a frozen preseason state. Combining this row-local state with completed-history count and hand-count selection tilts should improve current-group probabilities without using another validation or test row.

relationship_to_failed_parent.new_information: explicit current-season pitchmix state reconstructed from each row and frozen preseason counters; not present in BASE_FEATURES

data_contract.training_group_labels: Reconstructed only inside completed historical slices from next same-pitcher official pitchmix counters.
data_contract.validation_group_labels: Selector diagnostics and selection only; never an inference input.

row_local_state.preseason_state: For each pitcher, freeze the final completed-history row's asof_pitcher_pitchmix_n and rounded group counts; deliberately omit the unobservable last-pitch increment, consistently in validation and deployment.
row_local_state.current_season_state: Subtract the frozen preseason counts from the current row's official counters; invalid negative states fall back to zero.
row_local_state.features: current-season n/log-n, completed-state group rates, and EB current-season group rates/deltas at every registered k

completed_history_context.formula: Normalize current-season EB probabilities times (completed-history context probability divided by completed-history pitcher probability) to lambda.
completed_history_context.unseen_fallback: completed-history pitcher or league group probability

selector_models.base_catboost: Parent 400-tree BASE_FEATURES MultiClass selector, retained as the label-metric baseline only.
selector_models.state_catboost: Same fixed CatBoost parameters with the registered row-local state features appended.
selector_models.structured: Analytical row-local state plus optional completed-history context tilt.
selector_models.blend: Nonnegative probability blend of state_catboost and structured selector.

selector_selection.primary: maximum minimum reconstructed-pitch log-loss improvement versus base CatBoost across 2020 and 2021
selector_selection.secondary: maximum mean log-loss improvement, then maximum minimum top-1 accuracy improvement, then simpler context and stronger shrinkage

control_correction_after_selector_lock.direction: Selected group probability minus completed-history pitcher repertoire, multiplied by pitcher-by-group centered control effects; apply only to R exact-C.

source_gate.on_pass: Freeze selector and control parameters before 2022 and 2023.
